topic: Cracking the Code: Information Theory and Entropy in Wordle
target_audience: University students (CS or Data Science focus)

sections.title: The Intuition: What is Information?
lecture_lines: Information is the reduction of uncertainty.
Surprise drives how much we learn.
Binary splits provide exactly one bit.
animations: Visualize a single binary choice (Yes/No) turning into certainty. #FFFFFF

sections.title: The Strategy: Maximizing Information Gain
lecture_lines: Information gain reduces the decision tree.
animations: Display a decision tree branching out based on entropy. #FFFFFF (nodes), #00FF00 (paths)

Animate the tree pruning branches with low information gain. #FF0000

lecture_lines: Entropy drops with every new clue.
